# v3.21-dev

## Changed

- **Development sessions now start from the current code, automatically.** The
  container that runs a Claude Code session clones this repository when the
  container is *created*, not when the session starts — so a session could open
  on a checkout several releases old without anything saying so. The mistake
  surfaced only at version-bump time, after the work had already been written
  against the stale copy. One session opened 24 releases behind.

  A startup hook now runs before any work begins. It fetches the latest `dev`,
  brings the checkout up to date when doing so cannot lose anything, and
  otherwise says plainly how far behind it is and what to do about it. It also
  reports the version to bump from, read from the remote rather than the local
  copy, and installs dependencies so the linter, type-checker and build work
  straight away.

## Notes for self-hosted installs

**Nothing in this release changes the application.** No database changes, no
configuration changes, no behaviour changes — it affects only how development
sessions for this repository are set up. Installs can take it or skip it with
equal effect.
